alertOnNoData.description: Count a window with no data as a breach instead of skipping it.

apdexThresholdMs.description: `apdex`: the satisfied-latency threshold T in milliseconds.

breachesOutOf.description: Fire on `consecutiveBreachesRequired` breaches out of this many evaluations instead of in a row (up to 30).

comparator.description: `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`, `eq`, `neq`, `between` or `notBetween`.

consecutiveBreachesRequired.description: Breaching evaluations in a row before the rule fires.

consecutiveHealthyRequired.description: Healthy evaluations in a row before an incident resolves.

enabled.description: Whether the rule is evaluated. Defaults to `true`.

evaluationIntervalMinutes.description: How often the rule runs: 1, 5, 10, 15, 30 or 60. Unset uses Maple's default schedule.

minimumSampleCount.description: Skip windows with fewer samples than this.

name.description: Rule name, unique in the organization.

notificationTemplate.description: Custom notification `title` and `body`, with optional per-channel `overrides`. Write it with `jsonencode(...)`.

queryBuilderDraft.description: `builderQuery`: the query builder draft, as the dashboard's query builder saves it. Write it with `jsonencode(...)`.

rawQueryReducer.description: `rawQuery`: how rows reduce to one value: `identity`, `sum`, `avg`, `min` or `max`.

rawQuerySql.description: `rawQuery`: the SQL to evaluate.

renotifyIntervalMinutes.description: Re-send notifications for an open incident this often.

severity.description: `warning` or `critical`. Derived from `thresholds` when those are set.

signalType.description: What the rule measures: `errorRate`, `p95Latency`, `p99Latency`, `apdex`, `throughput`, `builderQuery`, `rawQuery` or `uptime`.

threshold.description: Breach threshold. Error rates are 0 to 1 ratios.

thresholdUpper.description: Upper bound for `between` and `notBetween`.

thresholds.description: Tiered thresholds, one per severity, as an alternative to `severity` + `threshold`: a list of `{ severity, value, upper, recovery_value, destinationIds }`. Read back from the API when unset. Write it with `jsonencode(...)`.

expiresAt.description: When the key expires, if it does.

expiresInSeconds.description: Lifetime from creation. Unset means the key does not expire. Changing it replaces the key.

keyPrefix.description: The visible start of the secret, as shown in Maple.

kind.description: `standard` (default) or `mcp`. Changing it replaces the key.

name.description: Key name. Changing it replaces the key.

rotate.description: Any value; changing it rolls the key: Maple revokes it and issues a replacement with the same name, description, kind and scopes, a new ID and a new secret. For example the `id` of a `timeRotating` resource.

scopes.description: Scopes like `dashboards:read` or `alerts:write`. Unset means full access. Changing them replaces the key.
